basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow (Chemistry and Chemical Biology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology at Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in a sponsored project under TexMiN Foundation (IIT (ISM) Project No. SRDP1422G). The tenure is twelve months or until the project is completed, whichever comes earlier. The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 per month plus HRA as applicable. Candidates need an M.Sc or M. Tech in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Environmental Science/Nanotechnology and a qualified GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score. They should email one PDF to [email protected]

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF containing: (i) CV, (ii) GATE/NET score card, (iii) self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates from class 10th, and (iv) proof of work experience (if any).
Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] by 6 December 2026.
Write "Application for the position of JRF under TEXMiN Project SRDP 1422G" in the subject of the email.
important_instructions: All documents must go in a single PDF, with the subject line exactly as given in the notice. The notice does not state a date or place for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow post: M.Sc or M. Tech in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Environmental Science/Nanotechnology. The candidate must have qualified the GATE/CSIR-UGC NET examination. Desirable: experience in synthesis of nanoparticles and their characterizations. The notice gives the age limit and relaxation as "As per the norms of the Govt. of India" and prints no age in years. Candidates should check the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000 per month plus HRA as applicable. The project tenure is twelve months, or until the completion of the project, whichever comes earlier. The notice states that the position may be converted into a regular JRF of the institute at any point, subject to the IIT(ISM) rule.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The job requires a basic academic background in chemistry, physics, materials science or nano material field. The candidate should have fundamental knowledge of chemical processes, sample preparation, and handling of laboratory apparatus and analytical instruments. Basic experience in the synthesis, processing and characterization of materials using techniques such as UV-Vis, FTIR, XRD, SEM and other relevant analytical tools is desirable. The candidate should be able to perform experiments, collect and interpret experimental data, and conduct scientific data analysis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare a single PDF containing: (i) CV, (ii) GATE/NET score card, (iii) self-attested copies of all mark sheets and certificates from class 10th, and (iv) proof of work experience (if any). Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] by 6 December 2026. Write "Application for the position of JRF under TEXMiN Project SRDP 1422G" in the subject of the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirements of the project. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed on the date of interview. Candidates must make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required, and no TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.
